canonical_statement: For every type alpha and nonempty family F of subsets of alpha, if membership in F has finite character, then F contains a member maximal under subset inclusion.
domain_and_universes: universe u; alpha : Type u; F : Set (Set alpha); Prop in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: Order.IsOfFiniteCharacter F: X is in F iff every finite subset of X is in F
conclusion: There exists m maximal among the members of F under subset inclusion.
